correctness.rationale: The published explicit conic and six-line intersections were independently reconstructed by exact symbolic arithmetic. The three old nodes are noncollinear; an allowed new line meets at most two. For any allowed line, Bézout and the local Tjurina values give Δτ=8+h+epsilon. The three node joins have nonzero conic restriction discriminants, so h=2 forces epsilon=0 and tau≤46. All three joins and exactly three noncomponent tangents through the old nodes attain tau46 and avoid forbidden old singularities. Existence and exhaustiveness follow from solving three quadratic dual-conic pencils. The degree-nine mdr≥4 and exact free/nearly-free Tjurina requirements (48,47) are applied to exclude both. The standalone code executed successfully, checking every critical coefficient and incidence; no finite sampling is elevated to an infinite theorem.

value.rationale: The exact sharp maximum and complete six-line equality classification settle the natural one-line extension route from an explicit degree-eight construction toward Gałecka’s still-open degree-nine case. The result differentiates two geometric equality mechanisms with different singularity baskets and precisely quantifies the one-unit Tjurina gap below near freeness. A natural complete classification and motivated construction boundary; it neither claims broad degree-nine nonexistence nor routine parameter inflation.
